faq.answer: Yes. Zennly works the same at one studio as at ten. You get online booking, artist and suite scheduling, deposits, discount approval and payment tracking from day one, and the multi-location views are there when you open a second studio.

faq.question: Can I book a makeup trial and the wedding date separately?
faq.answer: Yes. The trial and the wedding day are separate bookings, each with its own artist, suite, length and price, so both sit on the calendar and in the bride's payment record.

faq.question: How do I avoid double-booking an artist on a busy wedding date?
faq.answer: Every booking holds the studio, the artist, the suite and the service's real length together. Once an artist is booked at that time they can't be booked again, even from another device or studio.

faq.question: Can I schedule the whole bridal party?
faq.answer: Yes. The bride's makeup and hair and each bridesmaid's look are booked as separate services with their own artist and suite, so the whole party fits the morning without a clash.

faq.question: How does Zennly handle deposits and balances?
faq.answer: Payments are recorded against the booking by cash, card or online, including part-payments. You can take a deposit when the date is booked and see exactly what is still due until the balance is paid on the day.

faq.question: Does Zennly handle bridal party packages and gift vouchers?
faq.answer: Yes. Prepaid packages, such as a set of bridesmaid looks, and gift vouchers sit alongside regular bookings, so every redemption and remaining balance stays accurate.

faq.question: Can an artist work at more than one location?
faq.answer: Yes. Artist transfers are scheduled with the destination studio and date, for a single day or for good, so their bookings follow them and both managers see the change in advance.
